commits.message: Fix campaigns table responsive - use table-auto with whitespace-nowrap to prevent column overlap
Fix API key generation - use direct Firestore write instead of Cloud Function
Add API Key Management UI for automated imports in Data Import section
Add Cloud Functions: HTTP import endpoint + API key auth for automated daily imports
Responsive tables - compact layout, hide columns on smaller screens
Fix suppliers stats cards layout - equal width, compact spacing
Add suppliers collection to Firestore rules
Fix product import: Greek columns, comma decimals, auto-extract suppliers with TOD
Fix AI assistant icons, article navigation, add Priority Weights docs
Fix Button component: icon-only burger, styled primary/secondary buttons
TOD-based stock classification, supplier management page, burger menu
Update pricing to value-based tiers, add funding sources
Redesign dashboard, add campaign sorting and channel colors
ROI card redesign: dark gradient hero in Dashboard and ROI page
